_note: Passenger languages. Adding one = an entry here + data/i18n/<code>.json + words in data/lexicon/intents.json + messages in data/templates/messages.json. No code or retraining. 'asr' = the languages Whisper decodes for that passenger; 'scripts' tells the phonetic matcher which eSpeak-NG voice reads which writing system. 'espeak': null means spelling-only matching for that script; 'spaces': false splits its text into words by longest lexicon match.

scripts.name: Thai
scripts._why: eSpeak-NG's Thai phonemes are unusable, so Thai script uses spelling matching; Thai has no spaces between words, so text is split by longest lexicon match
